title: Agent Toolkit Install Receipt
description: Compatibility schema for installer receipts written under ~/.config/agent-toolkit/receipts/<target>-<product>.json. Matches Python agent_toolkit.installer.receipt and V agent_toolkit_core receipt.v (schemaVersion 1). Secrets MUST be empty. Artifact paths MUST NOT contain '..' segments (path-escape refuse). See docs/TRUST.md and docs/v/receipt-schema.md.

schemaVersion.description: Receipt format version. Only 1 is supported.

version.description: Toolkit version recorded at install time.

installedAt.description: ISO-8601 / RFC3339 timestamp when the receipt was written.

sourceDigest.description: Short digest of install source (profiles tree or version fallback).

artifacts.description: Installed files with digests and ownership.

configPatches.description: Optional JSON-merge / patch records applied to tool configs.

secrets.description: Always empty — receipts must never store secrets.

path.description: Absolute or resolved install path. Must not contain '..' path segments.

digest.description: Content digest (SHA256 hex truncated to 16 chars in current installers).
